items.title: BrainMem: Brain-Inspired Evolving Memory for Embodied Agent Task Planning
items.title_zh: BrainMem：面向具身智能体任务规划的类脑演化记忆
items.summary: BrainMem is a training-free hierarchical memory system that gives embodied agents working, episodic, and semantic memory, continuously transforming interaction histories into structured knowledge graphs and distilled symbolic guidelines. Across EB-ALFRED, EB-Navigation, EB-Manipulation, and EB-Habitat it improves task success, with the largest gains on long-horizon and spatially complex tasks.

items.title: Shattering the Shortcut: A Topology-Regularized Benchmark for Multi-hop Medical Reasoning in LLMs
items.title_zh: ShatterMed-QA：面向 LLM 多跳医学推理的拓扑正则化基准
items.summary: The authors introduce ShatterMed-QA, a bilingual benchmark of 10,558 multi-hop clinical questions built on a topology-regularized medical knowledge graph whose k-Shattering algorithm prunes generic hub nodes to sever shortcut paths. Evaluations of 21 LLMs show sharp degradation on these tasks, and restoring masked evidence through RAG triggers near-universal performance recovery.

items.title: Long-Context Encoder Models for Polish Language Understanding
items.title_zh: 面向波兰语理解的长上下文编码器模型
items.summary: The authors introduce a Polish encoder model that handles sequences up to 8,192 tokens through positional embedding adaptation and full-parameter continual pre-training, plus compressed variants trained by knowledge distillation. It achieves the best average performance among Polish and multilingual models on 25 tasks, with especially large gains on long-context tasks.

items.title: Multi-Step Semantic Reasoning in Generative Retrieval
items.title_zh: 生成式检索中的多步语义推理
items.summary: ReasonGR enhances multi-step semantic reasoning in generative retrieval for numerical contexts by combining task-specific instructions with stepwise reasoning guidance and a reasoning-focused adaptation module. Experiments on FinQA show improved retrieval accuracy and consistency for complex financial queries.

items.title: Test-Time Strategies for More Efficient and Accurate Agentic RAG
items.title_zh: 提升智能体 RAG 效率与准确性的测试时策略
items.summary: The authors modify the Search-R1 agentic RAG pipeline with a contextualization module that better integrates retrieved documents into reasoning and a de-duplication module that replaces previously retrieved documents. The best variant, using GPT-4.1-mini for contextualization, reports a 5.6% increase in exact match and a 10.5% reduction in retrieval turns on HotpotQA and Natural Questions.

items.title: When LLM Judge Scores Look Good but Best-of-N Decisions Fail
items.title_zh: 当 LLM 评审分数看起来不错时，Best-of-N 决策为何失败
items.summary: On a 5,000-prompt best-of-4 benchmark from Chatbot Arena, a judge with moderate global correlation (r = 0.47) captured only 21.0% of the improvement that perfect selection would bring. In a best-of-2 audit, explicit pairwise judging raised recovery from 21.1% to 61.2%.

items.title: LLM BiasScope: A Real-Time Bias Analysis Platform for Comparative LLM Evaluation
items.title_zh: LLM BiasScope：面向 LLM 对比评估的实时偏见分析平台
items.summary: LLM BiasScope is an open-source web application that compares outputs from multiple LLM providers side by side while running a two-stage bias detection pipeline on both prompts and responses.

items.title: BuilderIO/agent-native
items.title_zh: agent-native：构建智能体应用的 TypeScript 框架
items.summary: agent-native is a TypeScript framework for building agentic applications.

items.title: Kotlin creator's new language: talk to LLMs in specs, not English
items.title_zh: Kotlin 之父的新语言：用规格而非英语与 LLM 对话
items.summary: CodeSpeak is described as an agentic engineering toolkit that lets developers write programs in structured human language.
